target_concept: Use a HashSet to determine if all characters at a given index are identical across strings.

mcq.questionText: Given the strings "hello", "helpful", and "hell", a HashSet is used to collect the distinct characters at index 3 (the fourth character) of each string. What will be the size of the HashSet after processing this column?
mcq.explanation: At index 3 the characters are 'l' from "hello", 'p' from "helpful", and 'l' from "hell". A HashSet stores only unique elements, so it will contain {'l', 'p'}, resulting in a size of 2.
